description: Full Arnold render setup — sampling, motion blur, volume step size, output drivers. Final stage before farm submission.

orchestration_stages.label: Arnold ROP Node
orchestration_stages.description: Create and configure the Arnold ROP (output node) in /out context.
orchestration_hints: Single Arnold ROP at /out/arnold_render. Configure all settings on this node.

orchestration_stages.label: Sampling Configuration
orchestration_stages.description: Set AA samples and adaptive sampling thresholds.
orchestration_hints: Preview: AA samples 3, diffuse/specular 2.
Final: AA samples 8, diffuse/specular 4, volume indirect 4.
Enable adaptive sampling with noise threshold 0.015 for final.
Clamp indirect 10.0 to reduce fireflies.
artistic_constraints: AA minimum 3 for preview — not 1 or 2.
AA minimum 8 for final — not less.
Adaptive sampling on for final — saves render time.

orchestration_stages.label: AOV Configuration
orchestration_hints: Required AOVs: beauty (RGBA), diffuse_indirect, specular, emission, N (normal), P (position), Z (depth), motionvector.
Cryptomatte: cryptomatte_object, cryptomatte_material.
Volume AOVs: volume_scattering, volume_opacity.
artistic_constraints: All required AOVs must be present.
Emission AOV required for all scenes with volumetric FX.
Cryptomatte required — enables per-element masking in comp.
Depth must be in world units (Z pass) — not normalized.

orchestration_stages.label: Motion Blur Configuration
orchestration_stages.description: Enable and configure motion blur — object and volume.
orchestration_hints: Enable motion blur in Arnold render settings.
Shutter time: 0.5 (180 degree shutter equivalent).
Enable deformation blur for pyro volumes.
Volume velocity blur: enabled.
Motion steps: 2 for preview, 4 for final.
artistic_constraints: Motion blur MUST be enabled — no exceptions for cinematic work.
Volume motion blur required for pyro.

orchestration_stages.label: Volume Step Size
orchestration_stages.description: Set volume sampling step size for pyro resolution.
orchestration_hints: Preview: volume step size 0.1m.
Final: volume step size 0.02m.
Auto step size: disabled — set explicitly.
Max steps: 1000 for dense pyro.
artistic_constraints: Step size must be set explicitly — not auto.
Preview step too small = long render. Final step too large = banding.
Match step size to pyro simulation voxel size.

orchestration_stages.label: Output Path and Format
orchestration_stages.description: Configure output file path, format, and frame range.
orchestration_hints: Output format: EXR (OpenEXR). 16-bit half float for beauty, 32-bit for depth/motion.
Naming convention: $HIP/render/$OS/$F4.exr
Frame range: match to simulation range.
Single frame for preview, full range for final.
artistic_constraints: EXR only — no PNG/JPG/TIFF for production renders.
Output directory must be set — not default temp.
Frame range must be specified — not default [0,1].

orchestration_stages.label: Farm Submission Preparation
orchestration_stages.description: Final checks before submitting to render farm.
orchestration_hints: Verify all file paths resolve correctly.
Check memory estimate — alert if > 12GB per frame.
Confirm all dependencies (HDAs, textures, caches) accessible from farm.
Save HIP before submission.
artistic_constraints: Memory estimate must be checked — not ignored.
All paths must be absolute or farm-accessible UNC paths.
HIP must be saved before farm submission.

review_expectations.sampling: AA samples appropriate for quality tier. Adaptive enabled for final.
review_expectations.aovs: All required AOVs present. Cryptomatte configured.
review_expectations.motion_blur: Motion blur ON. Volume velocity blur enabled.
review_expectations.volume_step: Step size explicitly set. Matches sim voxel size.
review_expectations.output: EXR format. Output path set. Frame range correct.
review_expectations.farm_ready: Memory estimated. Paths verified. HIP saved.
